# n8n: n8n API key (public REST API)

`n8n-1` · API key / token · person. Each user creates keys in Settings > n8n API. The key is sent in the X-N8N-API-KEY header to /api/v1 and acts as that user.

Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant. "No docs found" means vendor documentation does not say either way.

| Question | Answer | Why | How |
|---|---|---|---|
| Identify: Admin can list all of them | No docs found | No vendor documentation found. |  |
| Protect: Admin can block or require approval | Yes | N8N_PUBLIC_API_DISABLED | Command: export N8N_PUBLIC_API_DISABLED=true (self-hosted env var) |
| Protect: SSO and MFA rules apply | No docs found | No vendor documentation found. |  |
| Protect: IP restriction | No docs found | No n8n-side IP allowlist for the API is documented; self-hosted operators can only restrict at their own network edge. |  |
| Protect: Expires automatically | Yes | Expiration chosen at creation | API key expiration: Settings > n8n API > Create an API key > Expiration |
| Detect: Usage appears in logs | Yes | userId | Where: Settings > Log Streaming > Add new destination > Events: Audit (n8n.audit), Workflow (n8n.workflow); filter on userId (Enterprise) · Command: N8N_LOG_STREAMING_MANAGED_BY_ENV=true N8N_LOG_STREAMING_DESTINATIONS='[{"type":"webhook","subscribedEvents":["n8n.audit","n8n.workflow"],...}]' |
| Detect: Data reads appear in logs | No docs found | Vendor docs neither confirm nor deny. |  |
| Respond: Revocation ends active access | No docs found | Docs do not say whether deletion is immediate. |  |
| Respond: Stops working when user is removed | No docs found | No vendor documentation found. |  |

## Protect: what an admin can configure

### Admin controls
- **N8N_PUBLIC_API_DISABLED** (Disable; Self-hosted only; default off). Turns off the public REST API for the whole instance. Where: Environment variable N8N_PUBLIC_API_DISABLED=true.
- **API key scopes** (Limit scope; Enterprise; default varies). Limits a key to chosen resource:action scopes. Where: Settings > n8n API > Create an API key > Scopes.
- **API key expiration** (Limit lifetime; all plans; default unknown). Key creator sets an expiration time. Where: Settings > n8n API > Create an API key > Expiration.

### Not available (vendor states)
- Scopes to limit a key are not available outside Enterprise; those keys have full account access.

- Network: unknown (checked at unknown). No n8n-side IP allowlist for the API is documented; self-hosted operators can only restrict at their own network edge.
- Lifetime: Expiration chosen at creation. Renewal: Create a new key and delete the old one.
- Keyless option: not_applicable. Static key; no workload federation for API keys documented.
- Conditions: No per-user admin block or approval flow documented for Cloud.

## Detect: what gets logged
- Token prefix: not established

### Logs
- Log streaming (Audit group): Enterprise. Destinations: syslog, webhook, Sentry. Retention depends on destination.

### Fields that identify the credential
- `userId` (workflow events): Identifies the user, not the key. No key ID field documented.

### Lifecycle events
- create: `User API created` Display name in Settings > Log Streaming > Events.
- revoke: `User API deleted` 

### Correlate on
`userId`, `workflowId`, `executionId`

### API calls a holder can make, and whether they are logged
- recon: `GET /api/v1/discover`. Endpoints and operations the key can use Logged: unknown. 
- enumeration (bulk): `GET /api/v1/users`. All users (owner only) Logged: unknown. 
- enumeration (bulk): `GET /api/v1/credentials`. Credential metadata, no secrets Logged: unknown. 
- collection (bulk): `GET /api/v1/workflows`. All workflows Logged: unknown. 
- collection (bulk): `GET /api/v1/executions?includeData=true`. Execution history and data Logged: unknown. 

### What to look for (analyst guidance)
- User API created for an account that does not normally automate
- Workflow created/updated/activated or Execution data revealed shortly after key creation

## Respond: how to revoke it
- Admin: **Delete API key**. Deletes the key. Where: Settings > n8n API > Delete > Delete Forever.

Delete the key in Settings > n8n API (as the key owner). On self-hosted, N8N_PUBLIC_API_DISABLED=true stops all key use. Live access ends on revocation: unknown. Docs do not say whether deletion is immediate.
